First Impressions

The big trend in the second half of 2025 is bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and that momentum is set to continue into 2026. Anker is leading the industry in this regard—their new portable MagSafe three-in-one charger packs 25W Qi2.2 support into an impressively compact form factor.

Active cooling is pretty much essential to achieve 25W wireless charging. Nearly every 25W charger on the market has this feature, and Anker's new foldable three-in-one charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charger and USB-C cable, which is enough to power your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously. With this charging stand, your iPhone 18 Pro can hit 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you ever loved that product but were disappointed when Apple discontinued it, you might be fond of this new offering. It's almost as portable as the MagSafe Duo, but with two key advantages: it can function as a desktop stand, and it can charge three devices at once instead of two.

One rather interesting (though honestly not strictly necessary) feature of this charger is that the Apple Watch charger uses a pop-up design. When folded, it tucks away inside; when you're ready to open it, a gentle press pops it out. I think this is a pretty clever design and makes the product's higher price point feel more justified.

The Bottom Line

Overall, if you're looking for a stylish and portable MagSafe three-in-one charger, this new offering from Anker is a solid choice. It has built-in active cooling, so you can fast-charge your iPhone without overheating or encountering the other problems that wireless charging can sometimes bring.

Anker's new three-in-one MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for $99, with free shipping for Prime members, in both black and white color options.
